name: NexNotch — Dynamic Island for GNOME
description: Dynamic Island for GNOME 49+. A MacBook-notch-style pill replaces the top clock and expands on hover into a tabbed hub: live system monitor (CPU/RAM/temp/network), Google Calendar & Tasks via GOA, dual-city weather, Pomodoro timer with stats, sticky notes, file drop shelf, notification peek, and quick system actions. Built by NexVar.
